pairs.kl_caveat: APPROXIMATE and a LOWER BOUND: symmetric KL over the union of top-k supports, renormalised, with an observed-minimum floor for out-of-top-k tokens. Understates exactly the positions where the models disagree most. Not true KL. Headline metric is mean_abs_logprob_delta, which is exact.
